relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a man with a GFAP variant: "Whole exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous c.212C>A missense mutation in exon 1 of the GFAP gene."
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; values typed into a short Python builder script in scratch (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). One in-scope person (the single unnamed patient, label 'patient'). Ref [4] (only other Indian AOAD report) gives no individual-level facts, so no row. First author surname taken as 'Kota' assuming the header lists surname first (cf. 'Sahoo Lulup Kumar', 'Karan Monica'); uncertain. Age at onset not stated as an age (only 'a 3-year history' at age 51), so onset age is not reported; '3-year history' kept as feature onset text with no ISO value. '51-year-old' recorded as age at last evaluation (age at presentation); age at diagnosis not stated. Ethnicity not stated (Indian origin only implied by 'only one case report of AOAD from India'), left not reported. Vital status not stated. Protein change not printed. Normal routine labs recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27. 'No family history of similar illness' not recorded as a feature of the patient. Checklist 'ataxia or cerebellar signs' left not reported: only ataxia is excluded (narrow vs broad rule). 'Dysphagia' left not reported although bulbar palsy is excluded. Bulbar palsy excluded while spastic dysarthria and slurred speech are observed; recorded both as stated (not treated as a contradiction). Autonomic dysfunction marked observed from urinary urgency/frequency (bladder dysfunction); orthostatic hypotension separately excluded. Supplementary material section is empty (video only).
